MOOINOOI KILLINGS

By: Nicky Troll | Delivery

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
We investigate the brutal rape and murder of two young women from Mooinooi.

Unique Selling Point:
EXCLUSIVE VIDEO OF MASTERMIND BEHIND THE MOOINOOI KILLINGS COMMISSION HITS ON THE WITNESSES.

Summary:
In December 2017 two young women were kidnapped, tortured, raped and murder allegedly at the hands of their ruthless criminal neighbour and his thugs.
The case has revealed horrific details of how the tragedy unfolded and what the women endured.
We reveal the lengths the mastermind will go to to ensure his freedom in an exclusive video taken inside the prison.

Further information:
BACKGROUND
The main suspect is Koos Strydom – we’ve featured him in 2013 as the Copper King of Rustenburg where he ran a string of scrap metal shops dealing in stolen copper.
Today he stands accused of:
- two murder charges,
- robbery with aggrevating circumstances,
- two kidnapping charges,
- three theft charges
- a charge of illegal possession of firearms and ammunition.

His co-accused are:
- his wife Mercia Strydom (22)
- two Mozambique nationals (18 & 25)
- Alex Modau (36)
*They have all been linked to the crime scene through DNA.

According to the police investigation – STrydom initiated the murders and the Mozambican brothers carried it out.

All charges against Vincent Strydom, his ex-girlfriend – Maroeca Opperman and Moses Rakubu were withdrawn – they have turned state witness. Mercia Strydom is currently out on bail.

WHAT HAPPENED

According to police testimony the women were picked up, and a rope tied around their necks and left so that the ropes would kill them.
Afterward wheelie bins were brought closer and the ropes that they were hanging from were cut and their bodies put in the rubbish bins. It was then taken to a stream on Strydom’s farm.

Strydom had a business on panelbeating business on the Van Niekerk’s plot. The Mozambicans worked for STrydom.

The women were taken to Strydom’s farm from the panelbeating shop. There Strydom and the eldest of the Mozambican brothers waited for them. On arrival the two brother attacked the women.

Die eldest brother raped one of the women in Strydom’s house while his wife Mercia looked on. The women were then taken to a shipping container and tied up. The Younger Mozambican brother untied one of the women, raped her and tied her up again. He then untied the second woman, raped her and tied her up again as well.

The eldest Mozambican brother was then given a contract for the women to sign – it is believed to have been the property sale contract.

The women were allegedly threatened at gun point to sign the contract. After they signed, the Mozambican brothers hung with ropes and left them to die.

The victims clothes were also put in the rubbish bins. Strydom’s wife Mercia brought the acid and Strydom the petrol that was used to burn the bodies. Their bodies were covered with wood and rubbish to make the fire stronger.

Strydom then told his son’s girlfriend to clean up the scene.

The women’s burnt out Nissan X-Trial was found in the MAgaliseburg area.

The police testified in February that they know of 5 other bodies that have been found at addresse where STrydom lived. The investigating officer said that while he isn’t saying Struydom committed the murders –it is strange that bodies were found at his home addresses.

A TRIAL OF DEAD BODIES UNCOVERED
The police testified in February that they know of 5 other bodies that have been found at addresses where Strydom lived. The investigating officer said that while he isn’t saying Struydom committed the murders –it is strange that bodies were found at his home addresses.

Witnesses are fearful – only now after Strydom’s arrest are other witnesses coming forward in the other cases. A body was found in a drain on a property in Koster where Strydom lived and a ntoher body hanging from a tree in the yard of one of the homes where the stayed in Rustenburg.

The police testified that STrydom has been found with cellphones in his prison cell on three occasions and that he could be planning an escape or tryihgn to have the witnesses taken out.

HITLIST FOR WITNESSES
We are able to prove the police’s theory – Koos Strydom is trying to have the witnesses killed. We have exclusive video evidence of this.

WHAT WE HAVE
- we have access to the plot where the murders took place
- we have interviews confirmed with the local journalist covering it
- someone that was present on the crime scene after the bodies were discovered – it will be a hidden identity interview as she believes she is on Strydom’s hitlist.
- Provisionally the families of both girls have agreed – just waiting to confirm
- SAPS also agreed in principle but waiting to confirm time.

RE-ENACTMENT

STRUCTURE

VO: The quiet mining town of Mooinooi in the North West was shaken by a dark turn of events in December 2017.

A local couple, Anisha and Joey van Niekerk mysteriously went missing. Shortly afterwards, 8 suspects would be arrested.

Koos Strydom believed to be the mastermind, his 22 year old wife Mercia, his son Vincent, Maroeska Opperman the son’s now ex-girlfriend, Moses Rakubu and Alex Modau – along with two Mozambican brothers employed by Koos .

The charges…. illegal possession of firearms, kidnapping, robbery, theft, rape and murder.

LINK: The couple // were last seen in town on the 10th of December last year – they were meant to go to Pretoria the next day to help make funeral arrangements for Joey’s dad who had just passed away – but they never arrived. [missing link]

VO: By the afternoon – their families were concerned and went to their smallholding to check on them. Anisha’s brother, Wynand van Niekerk, says they immediately got the sense that something was not right.

WYNAND: // the beds weren’t made up – nothing was packed // the aircon was on, the TV in the room was still on. // it just didn’t look like – according to what we could see they did not pack to leave for Pretoria /INT1 M13

VO: The family opened a missing persons report at the police station in Mooinooi. By the next morning a task team had been established according to Captain Mpeile Talane.

CAPTAIN: INT3 M3 We didn’t want to work on speculations – we wanted every team that we could get within the very same organization to come forward and assist us with the investigation //

VO: Local Journalist Daleen van Manen reported on the case from the start.

DALEEN: // Koos was arrested two days after the girls went missing – // I suspect one of the state witnesses who worked one the property must have said something. // INT1 M5

VO: Koos Strydom was known to the Van Niekerks – he was operating a panel beating business on their property. He lived on a smallholding, about 15 minutes away.

LINK: According to the police testimony – Anisha and Joey were brought to this small holding where Koos Strydom lived. They were apparently attacked by the Mozambican brothers and one of the women was raped in the house. Then they were brought to this shipping container. [container link]

VO: It’s believed at first, the women were tied up and only untied, to be raped and then tied up again.

LINK: The motive is apparently linked to the sale of the Van Niekerks plot – Koos Strydom wanted it and they weren’t accepting his offers. [motive link]

VO: Apparently they were forced at gunpoint to sign a sale agreement.

Once the business was concluded. It’s alleged that ropes were tied around their necks, they were strung up and hung.

WYNAND: I cant imagine // how you befriend someone with the intent to eventually try and steal land from them and eventually to kill them – I can not imagine. INT1 M26
VO: Ultimately the ropes that the women were hanging from were cut - bins were brought closer to the container, and it is alleged that Koos brought the petrol and his wife Mercia the acid.
LINK: // their bodies put in the rubbish bins and they were taken to a nearby stream and set alight. [bins link]

VO: We went to the scene of the crimes with Anisha’s brother, Wynand.

DEREK: What’s it like coming back now?
WYNAND: // I don’t know – you walk into this place, I don’t know, um, you just know that probably is the last place that they’ve been…. INT3 M2

VO: The last seven months have been extremely trying for the families, coming face to face with Joey and Anisha’s alleged killers in the Brits Magistrate Court.

WYNAND: Every time court is a confrontation with the reality with truth of what transpired during December, // you often catch yourself thinking this cant be true. INT1 M4

VO: Van Manen was shocked at the accused’s complete lack of remorse during court proceedings.

DALEEN: // even when all the gruesome details were revealed in court – not a flicker of emotion – nothing not in the eyes, not in the body language. INT2 M1

LINK: While 8 suspects were originally arrested all charges have been withdrawn against three of them and rifts seem to have appeared in the group. [rift link]

DALEEN: Three of the accused, Koos Strydom’s Son, his ex-girlfriend Maroescha and // Moses Rakubu – they were let go – all charges were withdrawn against them. And they turned state witnesses // INT1 M8
VO: Magistrate Semakaleng Thamage said during the bail application that Vincent Strydom drove the Van Niekerk’s car to Magaliesburg where it was burnt, while Opperman cleaned after they were killed.
While Mercia Strydom is out on bail – Alex Modau, the two Mozambican brothers accused of rape, and Koos Strydom, the alleged mastermind, are still in custody.

CAPTAIN: The DNA, the results in particular are giving us a link to say that this particular people that we have arrested are the ones who actually constituted this particular murder. INT2 M4 // this is the reason we have them behind bars at the moment. INT1 M12

LINK: But even from behind bars, Koos Strydom is not cut off from the outside world and it seems that some of trial witnesses may not be safe…. [witness link]

DALEEN: They were found twice with cellphones in the cells // so apparently threatening messages were sent from jail. INT2 M4

VO: But it’s a lot worse than just threatening messages…. Koos Strydom appears to be trying to have witnesses taken out. Just last week he tried to employ the services of a known assassin called Big Man.

In this exclusive video , Koos meets with an operative posing as Big Man’s criminal partner, at the prison where he is being held.
TRONK (1)
KOOS: Ek het 8 mense
OPERATIVE: jy’t 8 mense – so het jy vir Big Man gese per kop hoe werk hy?
KOOS: [draws 25 on the window] Twenty five each. Twenty five each
OPERATIVE: Oh – 25 each – 8 mense – is hulle die getuie daarso?
KOOS: ja… nie almal nie. Ander is ander dinge.
OPERATIVE: oh ok

VO: That’s 200 thousand rand to kill 8 people.

KOOS: ja nee, dis reg
//

OPERATIVE: hoe gaan ons werk? Hoe gaan ons werk?
KOOS: maak net soos julle wil (?)

KOOS: sodra jy reg is – my vrou sal betaal
OPERATIVE: okay

OPERATIVE: hoe gaan ons meet?
KOOS: daai man gaan net daar by my vrou – ek sal hom die adres gee van my vrou – hy kan net daar gaan sy gee hom cash.

VO: This isn’t the first time Carte Blanche crossed paths with Koos Strydom – in 2013 we exposed his dodgy scrap metal operations illegally buying copper – at the time he claimed to be a man of considerable means.

UPSOUND 2013 UNDERCOVER
Koos: 'Never show what you own. Rather look like a hobo. Look at me, I'm down to earth, but I'm a millionaire.'

VO: Koos not only agreed to pay top dollar for the job, he would also supply the weapons to do the deed.

OPERATIVE: nee ek meen die tools hoe gaan ons hom kry
KOOS: maklik – jy moet hom gaan haal in rustenburg
OPERATIVE: waar
KOOS: Rustenburg
OPERATIVE: by wie
KOOS: my vrou.
OPERATIVE: oh jou vrou sy sal ons gee – wat se sort is dit
KOOS: shhh – die mense gaan ons hoor…
OPERATIVE: ok. Ok….

VO: But Koos Strydom’s reputation precedes him. He has a chequered history – Koos was previously found guilty on charges of burglary and possession of suspected stolen goods.

And that appears to have only been the tip of the iceberg explains Van Manen.

DALEEN: The investigating officer said in court – dead bodies seem to follow Koos around – now during the investigations //they found a body in a drain in Koster that belonged to Koos, and then found a body hanging in his garden at his house in Rustenburg. INT5 M1

VO: And he is currently facing charges in a 2014 murder case confirmed Captain Talane.

CAPTAIN: the very same accused is actually linked with the murder case in Rustenburg – where the very same accused is going to appear in the Mogwase court.

VO: It seems with all his skeletons coming out of the cupboard, the gravity of the situation is starting to sink in for Koos.

This is from recorded telephone conversations between Koos and the Hitman – they are discussing the list of names that need to be taken out.

BIG MAN: Dis hoekom ek vra – wie is daai en daar?
KOOS: [???] Maroeska en Moses
BIG MAN: Ja
KOOS: En dan is dit die ander, ander ses.
CALL 5
KOOS: My vrou se Moses is onder police bewaking –
BIG MAN: Ok and then?
KOOS: Sy se as julle hom kan kry dan sal sy julle betaal – dis nie ‘n problem nie.
BIG MAN: Maar ek het jou gese ons sal hom kry mos.
//KOOS: Ek bel jou more oggend en dan se ek vir jou hoeveel deposit kan ek jou gee.

VO: They’re referring to co-accused and state witnesses Maroecka Opperman and Moses Rakubu – he is also a witness in the 2014 Rustenburg murder case.

The operative met with Koos’ wife - Mercia – when she came to visit him at prison - she appeared to be on board with the arrangements.

OPERATIVE: Hy het gese ek moet klaar maak met die getuies – dis hoekom ek is hierso.
WIFE: Ok, laat ek met Koos praat. Dan sal ek hoor – dan sale k jou bel.
K5 end
OPERATIVE: Ek vra net as ek daai mense klaar maak wie gaan my betaal
WIFE: Ek sal maar by Koos hoor oor die storie – laat ek by hom hoor en dan sal ek jou bel. //

VO: Mercia would later deny any knowledge of the hitlist, while Koos couldn’t be reached for comment – his prison phone was off and his lawyer didn’t respond to us.

DEREK: Have you heard that Koos Strydom is working on a hitlist?
CAPTAIN: We cannot confirm of the hitlist – however some of the witnesses like I’ve indicated have been trying to get us through information they were afraid that they might also fall or be threatened or be killed by the very same accused INT1 M8

VO: Stories Wynand has also heard from the local community.

WYNAND: I think the fear that was instilled in people through intimidation, through whichever way was very real for people. INT1 M30

VO: But Anisha and Joey’s families believe for them to find peace – Koos Strydom has to be stopped.

WYNAND: there is not a day that goes by that you don’t think about what happened INT1 M3 // // I cant imagine how that fear – how that must feel like // – and that makes me feel terribly sorry for them that they had to go through this. INT1 M28

VO: Exclusive prison videos show the lengths the mastermind behind the Mooinooi murder case will go to ensure his freedom – he’s been ordering hits on witnesses from behind bars.

VO: We reveal in an exclusive prsion video, how the accussed mastermind behind the Mooinooi murders, tries to hire a hitman to kill State witnesses.

PROMO 3

WYNAND: // I cant imagine how that fear – how that must feel like // –

VO: While their killers are behind bars, Carte Blanche investigates a plot to eliminate witnesses.

PROMO 4
VO: While the accused killers of Mooinooi couple Joey & Anisha van Niekerk are behind bars, the state witnesses may not be safe.

CAPTAIN: // some of the witnesses // were afraid that they might also fall or be threatened or be killed INT1 M8

VO: In a Carte Blanche exclusive, we reveal just how real the threats are - the alleged mastermind behind the horrific murders - attempts to hire a hitman, from behind bars.

metadata.One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...): We investigate the brutal rape and murder of two young women from Mooinooi.
metadata.Unique Selling Point: EXCLUSIVE VIDEO OF MASTERMIND BEHIND THE MOOINOOI KILLINGS COMMISSION HITS ON THE WITNESSES.
metadata.Summary: In December 2017 two young women were kidnapped, tortured, raped and murder allegedly at the hands of their ruthless criminal neighbour and his thugs. The case has revealed horrific details of how the tragedy unfolded and what the women endured. We reveal the lengths the mastermind will go to to ensure his freedom in an exclusive video taken inside the prison.
metadata.Further information: BACKGROUND The main suspect is Koos Strydom – we’ve featured him in 2013 as the Copper King of Rustenburg where he ran a string of scrap metal shops dealing in stolen copper. Today he stands accused of: - two murder charges, - robbery with aggrevating circumstances, - two kidnapping charges, - three theft charges - a charge of illegal possession of firearms and ammunition. His co-accused are: - his wife Mercia Strydom (22) - two Mozambique nationals (18 & 25) - Alex Modau (36) *They have all been linked to the crime scene through DNA. According to the police investigation – STrydom initiated the murders and the Mozambican brothers carried it out. All charges against Vincent Strydom, his ex-girlfriend – Maroeca Opperman and Moses Rakubu were withdrawn – they have turned state witness. Mercia Strydom is currently out on bail. WHAT HAPPENED According to police testimony the women were picked up, and a rope tied around their necks and left so that the ropes would kill them. Afterward wheelie bins were brought closer and the ropes that they were hanging from were cut and their bodies put in the rubbish bins. It was then taken to a stream on Strydom’s farm. Strydom had a business on panelbeating business on the Van Niekerk’s plot. The Mozambicans worked for STrydom. The women were taken to Strydom’s farm from the panelbeating shop. There Strydom and the eldest of the Mozambican brothers waited for them. On arrival the two brother attacked the women. Die eldest brother raped one of the women in Strydom’s house while his wife Mercia looked on. The women were then taken to a shipping container and tied up. The Younger Mozambican brother untied one of the women, raped her and tied her up again. He then untied the second woman, raped her and tied her up again as well. The eldest Mozambican brother was then given a contract for the women to sign – it is believed to have been the property sale contract. The women were allegedly threatened at gun point to sign the contract. After they signed, the Mozambican brothers hung with ropes and left them to die. The victims clothes were also put in the rubbish bins. Strydom’s wife Mercia brought the acid and Strydom the petrol that was used to burn the bodies. Their bodies were covered with wood and rubbish to make the fire stronger. Strydom then told his son’s girlfriend to clean up the scene. The women’s burnt out Nissan X-Trial was found in the MAgaliseburg area. The police testified in February that they know of 5 other bodies that have been found at addresse where STrydom lived. The investigating officer said that while he isn’t saying Struydom committed the murders –it is strange that bodies were found at his home addresses. A TRIAL OF DEAD BODIES UNCOVERED The police testified in February that they know of 5 other bodies that have been found at addresses where Strydom lived. The investigating officer said that while he isn’t saying Struydom committed the murders –it is strange that bodies were found at his home addresses. Witnesses are fearful – only now after Strydom’s arrest are other witnesses coming forward in the other cases. A body was found in a drain on a property in Koster where Strydom lived and a ntoher body hanging from a tree in the yard of one of the homes where the stayed in Rustenburg. The police testified that STrydom has been found with cellphones in his prison cell on three occasions and that he could be planning an escape or tryihgn to have the witnesses taken out. HITLIST FOR WITNESSES We are able to prove the police’s theory – Koos Strydom is trying to have the witnesses killed. We have exclusive video evidence of this. WHAT WE HAVE - we have access to the plot where the murders took place - we have interviews confirmed with the local journalist covering it - someone that was present on the crime scene after the bodies were discovered – it will be a hidden identity interview as she believes she is on Strydom’s hitlist. - Provisionally the families of both girls have agreed – just waiting to confirm - SAPS also agreed in principle but waiting to confirm time. RE-ENACTMENT
